headline: SARB decides today with the rand at R17.35/$; Wall Street ends mixed and AMD jumps 5.3%
summary: The rand was at R17.35 per dollar early on Thursday, weaker than R17.24 at 18:02 SAST on Wednesday and 3.5% weaker than Friday's R16.76, ahead of today's SARB rate decision with the repo rate at 7.25% (LRC Market Dashboard, 19 Nov 2026). The S&P 500 closed 0.2% lower at 7,323.63 and the Nasdaq 0.4% higher at 24,429.89 on Wednesday, with AMD up 5.3% and Nvidia down 2.9%. Gold closed at $3,717.90 (-2.1%), platinum at $1,356.90 (-3.8%), Brent at $89.17 (-3.7%) and copper down 4.0%, which keeps pressure on JSE miners after Wednesday's 3.7% fall in the All Share.

items.title: AMD +5.3% to $530.14; trading well above our fair value; rating unchanged
items.summary: AMD closed Wednesday at $530.14, up 5.3% on the day. It is on the LRC Investment watchlist with a SELL rating (grade B) and a fair value of $402.73, so the share now trades about 32% above that level. This note does not change the scanner rating.
items.source: LRC Stock Scanner quotes (Yahoo Finance), US close 18 Nov 2026 (23:00 SAST); LRC Watchlist

items.title: S&P 500 -0.2% at 7,323.63; Nasdaq +0.4% at 24,429.89
items.summary: The S&P 500 closed Wednesday at 7,323.63 against Tuesday's 7,340.53 (-0.2%), and the Nasdaq Composite at 24,429.89 against 24,328.38 (+0.4%). Both are about 3% below Friday 13 November (S&P 7,561.67; Nasdaq 25,136.27). Big single-share moves at the close included Palo Alto Networks +9.9%, UnitedHealth -10.2%, Take-Two +6.2% and Broadcom +3.6%.

items.title: SARB rate decision today; repo rate at 7.25%
items.summary: The SARB Monetary Policy Committee announces its decision on Thursday 19 November. The repo rate has been 7.25% since September's 25bp hike. October CPI, released on Wednesday, was 5.2% (September 4.5%).
